title: The Asymmetric Harms of LLM Compression

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating stereotypical preferences in occupational associations using the WinoBias benchmark, which compares model scores for pro-stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical pronoun resolutions.
Measuring reliance on racial stereotypes (e.g., African American subgroup) using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) multiple-choice question-answering dataset in ambiguous contexts.
Measuring reliance on socioeconomic stereotypes (e.g., Low SES subgroup) using the BBQ multiple-choice question-answering dataset.
Measuring reliance on disability-related stereotypes (e.g., Down's syndrome, cognitive disabilities, cerebral palsy) using the BBQ multiple-choice question-answering dataset.
Measuring reliance on nationality-related stereotypes (e.g., Italian subgroup) using the BBQ multiple-choice question-answering dataset.
Measuring reliance on age-related stereotypes using the BBQ multiple-choice question-answering dataset.
Measuring reliance on religious stereotypes using the BBQ multiple-choice question-answering dataset.
